issues.description: Method signature mismatch for Animal.messageOnFeed(): The problem statement UML and textual description specify an abstract method Animal.messageOnFeed() returning String (problem_statement.md shows the UML method signature at line 28). The template code and song-printing logic in Farm (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) expect to print the message as a String in verses. The solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java) instead declares public abstract FeedResponse messageOnFeed() and the concrete classes return FeedResponse objects. This inconsistency means a student implementing messageOnFeed(): String per the specification will produce a method signature incompatible with the solution's Animal and concrete classes (or vice versa), leading to compilation/signature mismatches and confusion about whether to use the FeedResponse wrapper or a plain String.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of Animal.messageOnFeed() consistent across all artifacts. Preferred (simpler) fix: change the solution to use String as the abstract return type (public abstract String messageOnFeed()) and update Seal/Pig/Goat implementations to return the feed message String (remove FeedResponse class or stop using it). Alternative: update the problem statement, UML, and template to require and document FeedResponse as the return type (and provide FeedResponse in the template) — but pick one approach and apply it everywhere so students and tests compile against the same signature.

issues.description: Concept: the animal feeding response returned by Animal.messageOnFeed(). Problem statement/UML: declares Animal.messageOnFeed(): String (the UML and textual description expect the method to return a String containing the feed message). Template: code and comments (Farm and Main) use message text directly (e.g., printing the return value) and therefore imply a String return. Solution repository: Animal.java declares public abstract FeedResponse messageOnFeed() (a custom FeedResponse type), Pig.java and Seal.java implement messageOnFeed() returning FeedResponse, but Goat.java implements messageOnFeed() returning String. This mixed typing (String vs FeedResponse) across artifacts and even within the solution itself prevents a clear mapping from the specification to the implementation, will confuse students about the expected return type and usage, and can cause compilation/type errors in pedagogical checks or when students try to follow the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the return type for Animal.messageOnFeed() across all artifacts. Preferred fix to match the UML and template: change Animal.messageOnFeed() to return String, update Pig and Seal to return the String message (e.g., "Oink!", "Arf Arf!"), update Goat (already returns String) to match, and remove or repurpose FeedResponse (delete the class or use it only internally, not as the method signature). Alternatively, if FeedResponse is intended pedagogically, update the problem statement, UML, and template to document messageOnFeed(): FeedResponse and update all implementations (Goat must be changed to return FeedResponse) so all artifacts consistently use FeedResponse and provide guidance on how to extract the textual message (e.g., via FeedResponse.getMessage() or toString()).
